This small plot is not mine — I rent it, so I don't want to spend cash on fertilizer from the cooperative for a perennial crop that takes years to pay back. I have some manure from the household, and I will put that on instead since it costs me nothing. For a perennial plot this size I mostly need to weed, prune, and harvest, which my family can do ourselves. I cannot afford pesticide or irrigation, and the seedlings were already planted before — I use what I have, not improved varieties.
